column3: BSB leaves out “and spoke with me” and “to me”; the Textus Receptus adds “to me.” “Punishment” renders κρίμα (“judgment”).
“Were immoral” renders “committed sexual immorality”; “intoxicated” renders “made drunk.”
“The angel” is added; “covered with” renders “full of.”
“A mysterious name” recasts “a name written, a mystery.”
“I could see that” is added; BSB leaves out the second “the blood” before “witnesses.” “I was utterly amazed at the sight of her” renders “I marveled, having seen her, with great wonder.”
“Now” and “but” are added; “will marvel when they see” renders “will be astonished … seeing.”
“This calls for” recasts “here is.” BSB puts “and they are seven kings” in verse 10.
BSB begins with “There are also seven kings,” which the Greek has at the end of verse 9; “only” is added.
“King” and “other” are added; “belongs to” renders “is of.”
“One hour of authority” recasts “authority as kings one hour.”
“To yield” renders the present διδόασιν (“they give”).
“Triumph over” renders “overcome”; “He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones” recasts “those with Him [are] called and chosen and faithful.”
“By uniting to give” recasts “and to do one purpose and to give.”
